name: To the Edge of the Sky
source:
Enter the year 2077 and become Seven, the newest addition to Phantom Alpha, a secret team who operates under the enigmatic government organization known as P.H.A.N.T.A.S.M. After joining, you find yourself befriending the other rookie on the team, an incredibly skilled youth known as Zero. As you meet the other members, you quickly learn that while vastly talented, each of them is clearly much more than meets the eye.

Regardless of your differences, you quickly learn what Phantom Alpha can do. But together, you soon discover that on the other side of the radiant world of light, lies an equally dark world of shadow. Can you brave these worlds and trust the men by your side?

[From [url=https://www.aeondreamstudios.com/tteots-free/]official website[/url]]

The heroes were initially based on the members of the Korean boy band BTS; however, after the developers received a cease & desist from the band's production agency in August 2018, the characters' likenesses were changed.
translation:
进入2077年，成为“幻影阿尔法”的最新成员“七号”，幻影阿尔法是一个秘密团队，隶属于神秘的政府组织“P.H.A.N.T.A.S.M.”。加入后，你会发现自己与团队中的另一位新秀成为了朋友，他是一位技艺精湛的年轻人，被称为“零”。当你见到其他成员时，你很快就会发现，虽然他们才华横溢，但他们每个人显然都比表面上看到的要多得多。

无论你有何差异，你都可以快速了解Phantom Alpha的功能。但在一起之后，你很快就会发现，在光辉灿烂的世界的另一边，隐藏着同样黑暗的阴影世界。你能勇敢地面对这些世界并信任你身边的人吗？

[来自[url=https://www.aeondreamstudios.com/tteots-free/]官网[/url]]

这些英雄最初是基于韩国男孩乐队BTS的成员；然而，在开发商于2018年8月收到乐队制作机构的停止令后，角色的肖像发生了变化。
